en: Illustrated seaside scene showing men, women and children on a sandy beach in early 20th‑century style bathing costumes. A girl in a red‑and‑yellow striped one‑piece swimsuit stands in the center foreground, a boy in a white shirt and green shorts plays with a bundle of clothes near the surf, and other bathers wade in the shallow water. In the background, there is a low pavilion or bathhouse building and more people strolling along the shore. The image has the look of a color lithograph typical of vintage holiday postcards.
